array.string: /usr/bin/log stream --style syslog --predicate 'process == "sudo" OR process == "su" OR process == "sshd" OR process == "sshd-session" OR process == "logger" OR process == "sysadminctl" OR process == "dscl" OR process == "dseditgroup" OR process == "screensharingd" OR process == "XProtect"' >> "$HOME/Library/Logs/macos_security.log"
